name: Lost Sheep Parable Of
overview: The Lost Sheep Parable powerfully illustrates God's relentless pursuit of the one who has gone astray, as shown by the shepherd who leaves the ninety-nine to seek the lost sheep in the mountains and wilderness. Upon finding the lost sheep, the shepherd rejoices greatly, carrying it home and calling others to share in the joy, highlighting the immense value and celebration in heaven over one sinner who repents compared to many who do not need repentance. This parable reveals the heart of God’s grace and mercy, emphasizing that every individual is precious and worth seeking with unwavering love.
